title: Authenticate the European row-copy and Color Mode source families
changes: Trace all four original row-copy callers, the adjacent CPUSet copy and the complete aligned reference set for the six Color Mode banks. Merge the 44-byte source overlap and declare the independent pointer and literal spans.
validation: Wine source units mps06f1y and 2smdx7sg passed and drained. They verify the five table readers, including the two queued transfers and both 32-byte odd-bank slices. The 14-span plan accounts for 10,452 bytes outside e320-d319 ownership.
limitations: Runtime publication, original scene entry, other mode writers, value 3, indirect readers, both gaps and deferred platforms remain open. No performance measurements. Primary Terra/xhigh settings unconfirmed.
